name: Radu Popescu
bio: Radu Popescu's journey into motorsport wasn't direct, but his impact is undeniable. After two decades in human resources across various industries in Romania, Radu's passion for racing, fueled by his father's stories of rally driving in the '70s, led him to seek a role within the sport. He joined JHR Developments five years ago, bringing a wealth of experience in talent acquisition and employee relations. Radu believes in fostering a positive and supportive work environment, recognizing that the dedication and well-being of the team are crucial for success on and off the track. His ability to identify and nurture talent, combined with his deep understanding of labor laws, makes him an invaluable asset to JHR.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Radu is a stocky man of average height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Prefers to conduct interviews while walking around the office, believing it puts candidates more at ease.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
